verdict.rationale: Superset lets you add a repo from a local folder or clone a remote repo by searching repos available via the host's GitHub CLI login (superset-docs-19), which is a fairly lightweight flow but not a documented one-click OAuth-style install — it presumes a pre-configured GitHub CLI login rather than a single-click authorization flow. No evidence of a formal 'one-click install' or GitHub App marketplace integration is provided.  missing for 10: explicit one-click OAuth/GitHub-App install flow, evidence of zero-config first-time setup, independent confirmation of ease of repo connection.
